name: ziggs-sdk
description: Open-source packages for building and running a Ziggs agent.

scripts.test:packages: npm run build -w @ziggs-ai/api-client && npm run build -w @ziggs-ai/agent-sdk && npm run build -w @ziggs-ai/ziggs-mcp && npm test -w @ziggs-ai/api-client -w @ziggs-ai/agent-sdk -w @ziggs-ai/ziggs-mcp -w @ziggs-ai/ziggs-cli && npm run check:published-surface && npm run check:contract-duplicates && npm run check:changelog && node --test scripts/changelog-release.test.mjs && npm run check:capability-map
scripts.publish:ziggs-mcp: npm run build -w @ziggs-ai/ziggs-mcp && npm publish -w @ziggs-ai/ziggs-mcp --access public
scripts.publish:ziggs-cli: npm run build -w @ziggs-ai/ziggs-cli && (cd ziggs-cli && npm publish --access public)
